reviews.text: If I could give zero stars, I would have; he's the worst vet in the world.
It was my cat's first vaccinations; the vet and her technician were super nice. He didn't notice a thing and was purring.

I adopted a dog, Bean, in April 2026. We quickly made an appointment at the Tout Chat Tout clinic for his veterinary care. The first visit went well. Bean received an unscheduled vaccination and a booster appointment for the following month. At that time, the vet also prescribed anti-nausea medication.
During the second visit, a complete evaluation was performed again, even though a full examination had already taken place a month prior. This consultation cost us over $150. I took the opportunity to mention that the anti-nausea medication hadn't worked. The vet recommended increasing the dose by half a pill, but this adjustment was also ineffective.
A few weeks later, Bean began exhibiting more aggressive behavior. I contacted the SPCA for advice on how to best manage him, and they suggested I resume the prescribed sedatives. So I contacted the clinic to confirm this recommendation and, at the same time, remind them that the anti-nausea tablets ($60 for four tablets) had never been effective.

Unfortunately, the customer service experience was very disappointing. During my call, I felt judged rather than listened to. The receptionist was curt and simply told me the veterinarian would call me back. A week later, having received no response, I called again and was told the same thing. The next day, I finally received a text message offering me an appointment... at the end of August, which didn't meet my immediate needs.

I then expressed my dissatisfaction with the service I received and requested that Bean's file be transferred to another clinic. The file was indeed transferred, but, to my surprise, the clinic also forwarded my communications expressing my dissatisfaction, without notifying me or obtaining my consent. Overall, my experience was very disappointing. As a new dog handler, I was looking for advice, support, and professional guidance. Instead, I felt unheard, judged, and poorly supported. For these reasons, I do not recommend this clinic.

I was nervous going to a new vet, especially as an English speaker who recently moved here. The vet and the receptionist were both bilingual and were helpful. The price was reasonable, too. No overcharge or selling extra products.
Attentive and friendly service. You can feel their passion for caring for animals.
Excellent service! I appreciated the advice and care for my cat.

A huge thank you to France, Isabelle, and the rest of your wonderful team. An independent veterinary clinic where the human touch is paramount. Where consultations and procedures are performed in the presence of the owners—it's so important. Hoping that the new generation of veterinarians in Quebec will be inspired by your expertise and your approach. ❤️

Lady loved her first experience at Tou ChatTou Veterinary, from the receptionist {Receptionist ☺️} to the doctor! Thank you for treating her so well and making her feel so comfortable! Pleasantly surprised 🫶🏾 Lady thanks you wholeheartedly and see you very soon for her next vaccinations 🦴 …

A professional, caring, and friendly team. One of the few veterinary clinics where you're not pressured into unnecessary preventative tests or made to feel guilty about your choices regarding your animals. You can tell you're dealing with competent people, guided by the genuine well-being of the animal, and not by the interests of pharmaceutical companies.
Great clinic, very professional and they don't push for unnecessary procedures on our animals, very good advice and the prices are well placed when I compared with quite a few clinics in Montreal.

My two cats are patients at this clinic, and I highly recommend it! My older cat had a fracture in her left leg, and she was treated with such compassion and kindness, despite her being a bit fierce at times. I truly appreciate the human touch of all the staff; it's reassuring to know they're in good hands. My cat had a high-quality cast that stays on perfectly and isn't easily removed.

I'm so glad I discovered this place. (Thanks to my friend Gilbert).

A really warm welcome and the girls are lovely.

The service is perfect and they go out of their way to make sure we're happy.

Plus, they provide excellent follow-up.

Don't hesitate to check out this little shop, where you feel truly welcome!

A big thank you, girls! 🙏

After disappointing experiences with another clinic in the area, I tried this one for the first time and I wasn't disappointed. The staff were kind and welcoming. The vet was gentle with my cat and clearly explained the results of her diagnosis. Overall, good communication and reasonable prices. Highly recommended if you're in the area.

The clinic is calm, rarely more than one client at a time. It's perfect for my nervous little guy. The vet was attentive. I received excellent service from all the staff. The only downside is to check when they'll be on vacation, as the clinic is closed.
Fantastic clinic! I loved the service, and the vet was very warm and professional. This is my second time going there, and I highly recommend it.
Perfect clinic for my two nice cats, Always very kind and pleasant attitude. They can advise and answer all possible questions Good prices. Thank you♥️
Very gentle and kind to our puppy, he stayed quite happy even after vaccines :)
I used this veterinarian's services throughout my little dog Bobo's life. She's the best vet in Montreal. She's highly skilled. Bravo to all her!

I 100% recommand this place! Staff is awesome and you see that the vet and staff cares for your animal. It’s not a money grab like other big vet companies and the vet really gives you her profesional advice. She’s not after your money but the well being of your animal…which is rare these days.
Excellent vet with very welcoming staff who are very attentive to our furry friends. Your pets are in good hands at Tou Chat Tou!
The clinic is clean and the staff very caring. The vet gave us good advice for the future, and our cat received very gentle care. I would gladly return.

Went for our two cat’s checkups and received great care. Staff are quite friendly and our cats stayed calm, which is relatively uncommon for one of our cats. Very happy with the service and the cats seem to be happy too, which is always a plus.

I have nothing but praise for my first experience at this clinic.

The place is clean and quiet. The staff is fantastic, as is the veterinarian. My cat received excellent dental care (scaling), and I can see from her behavior that she's much happier now. The prices are also very reasonable compared to other clinics. Thank you so much, Clinique Tou-Chat-Tou, for your services!

Extremely horrible experience with this lady vet and her staff in the summer of 2022. Rude staff. Had to seat on a chair far away from the exam table and the vet to answer her questions. Felt like in a prison. She called herself vet, but cannot give a vaccin to our small chihuahua, when I told her that, she rudely said: I am a vet, I am not superwoman. WoW . What a waste of money and time. Plus you have to buzz the door to get in, and the strange receptionist girl  behind the desk took her time to let you in, what’s her problem? Never again, and I suggest to dogs lovers to do not go there.
I recommend coming here; it's very professional, this is my new place. Well done to everyone who works here!
